title: RightDerivedBaseChangeSingleUnitHomology
statement: Let B, B′, C, C′ be abelian categories with derived categories, with enough injectives in B and B′ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let G : B → C and G′ : B′ → C′ be additive and beta : B → B′, gamma : C → C′ additive exact [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology]. For e : G ⋙ gamma → beta ⋙ G′ and Y in B, use the homology augmentations a⁺ defined in [lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison]. Then gamma(a⁺_G(Y)), followed by the exact gamma homology comparison, H⁰ of derived base change on Y[0], and H⁰ of R⁺G′ applied to the beta single-complex comparison, equals e(Y) followed by a⁺_G′(beta Y). This equation uses no classical right-derived comparison and no left exactness of G or G′.

proof.text: Evaluate rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac on the homotopy single complex Y[0]. Expand the auxiliary transformation and transport by the canonical single-complex isomorphisms; associators disappear and the levelwise transformation is the single complex of e(Y). Naturality transports the target along beta.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor.

Apply H⁰ and the exact gamma homology comparison. Its naturality moves the source unit through that comparison. The single-complex H⁰ identification identifies the levelwise map with e(Y); this gives the claimed equation of homology augmentations. The single-complex compatibility used here is mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso_hom_app_singleFunctor, already proved in ExactFunctor.lean.
